gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-cossette-tex: Outrun Future spaces its letters wide and traces them in a single-width outline, pure synthwave swagger. Cossette Texte brings a generous x-height and open-eyed e shapes that keep a full page of text easy on the eye.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-gafata: Authoritative with a synthwave edge, Outrun Future draws every line with no pressure variation at all. Gafata sits below with a tall band of small letters and short stalks, a quiet foil to that steady outline.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-hedvig-lette: Every stroke of Outrun Future, horizontal or vertical, carries the same weight, which gives it that synthwave authority. And if the heading shrinks, Hedvig Letters Sans, with its near-capital lowercase, starts to compete.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru reads crisp, with lowercase pressing up near the ascender height. Give Outrun Future the large sizes, since its wide spacing and constant outline want room, and let Hind Mysuru handle the text.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-hind-siligur: Outrun Future is all synthwave authority, wide-spaced and outlined. Hind Siliguri does the quieter job, with a flat gray hum of constant weight and round shapes that gap like a cracked bangle.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-mochiy-pop-p: Outrun Future stretches its letters wide and traces them in a constant-width outline, with real authority. Mochiy Pop P One counters with wide gaps between letters and a sizable lowercase, making paragraphs feel open and friendly.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-montserrat-u: A wide-set, constant-width outline gives Outrun Future its synthwave command. Montserrat Underline brings oversized lowercase and round bowls of unwavering line, so reading through a full page of text feels open and steady.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-nokora: Nokora lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line, its s never pinching shut. Nokora makes a full paragraph feel inviting, a sturdy counterweight to the marker-like line of Outrun Future.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-noto-sans-be: Noto Sans Bengali keeps its capitals barely taller than lowercase, with distinctly open letter mouths throughout. And the strongest pull comes from Outrun Future, whose joins hold their full thickness where strokes meet.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-noto-sans-ch: Outrun Future is synthwave authority in a plain stripe of constant ink. The best move here is the foil Noto Sans Chakma provides, with lowercase packed toward the caps and uncrowded mouths on the s and c.
